_note: Key path: transit_planet -> aspect_character. Localizes a timing note without rewriting the main theme.

Moon.fallback: The Moon puts the timing in the body first, especially through {house_theme}.
Moon.challenging: The Moon puts the pressure in the body first around {house_theme}; let the first feeling speak without making it the whole story.
Moon.flowing: The Moon softens the opening around {house_theme}; rhythm may carry more than force.

Mercury.fallback: With Mercury, timing localizes through language and interpretation in {house_theme}.
Mercury.challenging: Misreadings or overthinking can collect in {house_theme}; Mercury wants cleaner language here.
Mercury.flowing: Mercury opens more room for planning, naming, or useful conversation in {house_theme}.

Venus.fallback: Venus makes value, pleasure, or reciprocity the live thread in {house_theme}.
Venus.challenging: In {house_theme}, Venus asks what the exchange is really costing.
Venus.flowing: In {house_theme}, Venus eases the exchange and makes pleasure or agreement easier to trust.

Mars.fallback: Mars puts heat and directness into {house_theme}.
Mars.challenging: The temperature rises in {house_theme}; aim the energy before it spends you.

Jupiter.challenging: Scale gets tested in {house_theme}; more is not automatically better.
Jupiter.flowing: Confidence has more room to stretch through {house_theme}, especially where things have felt cramped.

Saturn.fallback: Saturn asks {house_theme} to hold a firmer shape.
Saturn.challenging: If {house_theme} has been running without structure, Saturn makes that obvious.
Saturn.flowing: Steadier support is available in {house_theme} when the structure is real.

Uranus.fallback: Uranus disturbs the settled pattern in {house_theme}.
Uranus.challenging: Expect an interruption in {house_theme}; the break in pattern may be the message.
Uranus.flowing: A freer route opens through {house_theme}, especially where habit has gone stale.

Neptune.fallback: Neptune makes {house_theme} more porous, sensitive, or imaginal.
Neptune.challenging: Edges blur in {house_theme}; discernment matters more than instant certainty.
Neptune.flowing: Imagination, softness, or compassion moves more easily through {house_theme}.

Pluto.fallback: Pluto brings the deeper pressure point into {house_theme}.
Pluto.challenging: What has been managed in {house_theme} takes on more weight; naming the pressure is already a change.
Pluto.flowing: A deeper honesty becomes available in {house_theme}, especially when the surface answer is too small.
